The inspector resolves the selected EntityRef, exposes typed editable fields with unit/provenance context, and queues EditorOperationIntent values rather than directly mutating the model.

The catalog gives capabilities stable ids, named groups, explicit routes, status values and prerequisite keys. Its own contract says availability describes executable UI routes and routes do not mutate.

The shared types define EntityRef and EditorOperationIntent. Desktop routing invokes the Rust operation applier through Tauri and uses the same crate through wasm where applicable; batch outcomes distinguish validation, temporary-state simulation, atomic commit, diagnostics, submitted untrusted metadata and acceptance evidence.
